bind_address.description: Network interface to bind the dashboard server to.

port.description: HTTP(S) port for the web interface.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging and auto-reload.

model_cache_dir.description: Directory to cache downloaded model artifacts.

database_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file storing metadata and logs.

max_concurrent_inferences.description: Maximum number of simultaneous inference requests the dashboard can handle.

inference_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for inference requests before aborting.

use_https.description: Enable HTTPS using the provided TLS certificate and key.

cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (used only if HTTPS is enabled).

key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (used only if HTTPS is enabled).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level for the dashboard server.

log_file.description: Path to the dashboard server log file.

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI (used if auth_backend is 'ldap').

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN for binding to the LDAP server (used if auth_backend is 'ldap').

ldap_password.description: Password for LDAP bind DN (used if auth_backend is 'ldap').

ldap_search_base.description: Base DN to search for users (used if auth_backend is 'ldap').

ldap_search_filter.description: Filter to match usernames during authentication (supports '{{username}}' placeholder).

ldap_user_group.description: Optional group DN to require for access (used if auth_backend is 'ldap').

oauth2_provider_url.description: OAuth2 provider base URL (used if auth_backend is 'oauth2').

oauth2_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID (used if auth_backend is 'oauth2').

oauth2_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret (used if auth_backend is 'oauth2').

oauth2_redirect_uri.description: OAuth2 redirect URI (must match provider configuration).

models.description: List of models to expose in the dashboard.

path.description: Absolute path to the model file (e.g., /models/yolov5s.onnx)

labels.description: Optional path to class labels file or inline JSON array

default_device.description: Default device to use for inference.

devices.description: Explicit device assignments for multi-accelerator setups.

rate_limit_rpm.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute per IP address.

audit_logging.description: Enable logging of user actions (login, inference requests, configuration changes).

audit_log_file.description: Path to the audit log file (used only if audit_logging is enabled).

frontend_dir.description: Directory containing frontend assets (HTML, JS, CSS).
